question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the events concerning the College of the Chancellery: his appointment as one of its members, his appointment as its president, and its abolition.
why_needs_multiple: Ba mốc cùng một cơ quan (thành viên, chủ tịch, bãi bỏ) trong 1785–1789; cần đủ cả ba.
criterion: events about the College of the Chancellery: his appointment as a member, his appointment as its president, or the abolition of the College

question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list his appointments to royal court posts, namely chamberlain, senior chamberlain and head steward for the queen.
why_needs_multiple: Ba lần bổ nhiệm vào chức danh triều đình cùng loại (1774–1789); cần đủ cả ba.
criterion: appointments to royal court posts: Chamberlain, senior Chamberlain, or Head Steward for the queen

question: Counted by calendar year, how many years passed from his becoming the regular Commission Secretary in Vienna until he was sent on diplomatic missions to several German states?
why_needs_multiple: Hai mốc đích danh ở hai thời điểm (1772, 1778); khoảng cách không suy ra từ một mốc.
criterion: time gap between his regular Commission Secretary post in Vienna and his diplomatic missions to German states

question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the occasions on which he chaired a committee of the Parliament.
why_needs_multiple: Hai lần chủ trì ủy ban Quốc hội (1809, 1815) cùng loại; chỉ có hai mốc nên dùng list, không dùng summary.
criterion: chairing a committee of the Parliament
